headline: Principal NLP Researcher
summary: Senior researcher with extensive experience leading large‑scale language model projects across academia, big‑tech research labs, and AI startups. Expertise spans transformer architecture design, distributed training on GPU/TPU clusters, RLHF alignment, and efficient fine‑tuning techniques. Proven track record of delivering latency‑optimized models that power products serving millions of users and generating multi‑million‑dollar revenue streams.

experience.title: Principal NLP Researcher
highlights: Led a team of 8 researchers to deliver a 70B‑parameter multilingual LLM that achieved 12% lower latency on A100 GPUs via kernel fusion and INT8 quantization, deployed in an internal assistant serving 2M daily active users.
Designed a mixed‑precision training pipeline using JAX and Pallas that cut training FLOPs by 18% while keeping perplexity within 0.2 of baseline on the Pile dataset.
Authored an internal RLHF‑with‑AI‑feedback study that increased win‑rate against a GPT‑4 baseline by 7% on human preference tests, shaping the 2025 product roadmap.
Secured $3.2M of internal funding for infrastructure, negotiated procurement of 256 H100 GPUs and optimized Slurm scheduling to reach 92% cluster utilization.

experience.title: Senior Research Scientist
highlights: Built an end‑to‑end speech‑to‑intent pipeline using a Conformer encoder and a 1B‑parameter LLM, reducing latency from 820 ms to 460 ms on V100 GPUs and enabling real‑time handling of 150 concurrent calls per instance.
Pioneered a LoRA‑based fine‑tuning method with only 0.3 % trainable parameters, matching full‑fine‑tuning accuracy while cutting GPU memory usage by 64 %.
Mentored four junior researchers and interns, two of whom were promoted to research scientist roles within 12 months.
Published three ACL‑workshop papers on efficient inference, collectively cited 110 times by end of 2023.

experience.title: Research Scientist
highlights: Contributed to the development of the T5‑XL model, implementing distributed training on TPU v3 pods that reduced training time from 14 days to 9 days for a 11B‑parameter checkpoint.
Designed a data‑filtering pipeline that removed 22% of noisy web‑text while preserving downstream task performance, saving ~1.4PB of storage.
Led a cross‑team effort to integrate sparsely‑gated Mixture‑of‑Experts layers into the Transformer, achieving a 1.4× throughput increase at equal accuracy.
Authored 5 conference papers (NeurIPS, ICML, EMNLP) with combined citations exceeding 850.

experience.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
highlights: Developed a neural transition‑based dependency parser that attained 94.2% UAS on the Penn Treebank, setting a new state‑of‑the‑art for parsers without external embeddings.
Released an open‑source toolkit for multilingual word‑embedding alignment, downloaded over 12,000 times in its first year.
Supervised three MSc projects; all students graduated with distinction and two continued to PhD programs.
Awarded a £150k EPSRC grant to investigate syntax‑aware language modeling, resulting in a journal article in TACL.

certifications: Co‑author, 'Scaling Laws for RLHF in Large Language Models', ACL 2023
Inventor, US Patent 11,845,678: 'Efficient LoRA Adaptation for Transformers', 2022
First author, 'JAX‑Pallas Mixed Precision Training for LLMs', NeurIPS 2022
